name: Isibo Brewery
about: Isibo Brewery is the English form of 이시보, an agricultural company at Dowonnam-ro in Daejeong-eup, Seogwipo, on Jeju. A press piece describes its makgeolli as brewed with glutinous rice grown on Jeju.

Its Isibo Wonju is a takju bottled at 15.5 percent in 330 millilitres. The label lists Jeju glutinous rice, purified water, domestic non-glutinous rice and nuruk, says it contains wheat, and gives a 150 day shelf life from bottling if kept refrigerated below 10 degrees.
